dict.string: AISEE-BIN connects to your AiSee glasses over Bluetooth so their camera and button can guide you.
AISEE-BIN uses the camera to track your position inside the greenhouse and guide you between exhibits.
AISEE-BIN does not read your contacts. This permission text is required because the AiSee glasses’ audio library can announce caller names; the app never asks for it.
AISEE-BIN receives the glasses’ live video over their local Wi-Fi hotspot.
AISEE-BIN does not use your location. This permission text is required because the AiSee glasses’ audio library can use location; the app never asks for it.
AISEE-BIN does not use your location. This permission text is required because the AiSee glasses’ audio library can use location; the app never asks for it.
AISEE-BIN listens for spoken commands such as "take me to the Orchid Display" when you press the talk button.
AISEE-BIN counts your steps to keep guiding you between position fixes when the phone is in your pocket.
AISEE-BIN converts your spoken commands to text so it can pick a destination or answer where you are.
